messages:
Anna L: Quick sync — we need to schedule a combined threat-modeling + access-review session for SOC2 prep. Prefer next week. Options: Tue 9am PT, Wed 10am PT, Thu 11am PT. Need owners and a short agenda. @Raj P @Kelly D can you join? :eyes:

Mike R: Wed 10am PT works best for me. If it's tight, I'm fine with Tue too.

Raj P: Wed 10am PT is good. Can we cover service-account inventory + RBAC matrix? I can bring a draft.

Kelly D: Wed 10am PT ok for compliance. Also we need the evidence checklist (user access logs, onboarding/offboarding, KMS access policy). I'll drop a baseline checklist in Confluence.

Sophia C: +1 Wed 10am PT. Suggest 75 min slot so we don't rush: 15m overview, 30m threat modeling, 15m access review, 15m action items & owners.

Anna L: Sounds good. Proposed agenda (short):
```
- 5m: goals & scope (SOC2 areas to cover)
- 30m: threat modeling (service boundaries, sensitive flows)
- 15m: access review (user roles, service accounts, KMS)
- 20m: evidence mapping & owners
- 5m: next steps / timeline
```

Anna L: Action items to confirm before the meeting: upload service map, RBAC export, and current onboarding/offboarding doc. Can everyone add links here when ready?

Raj P: I'll upload a service-account inventory and a quick script to generate it. Command I used: `gcloud iam service-accounts list --format="table(email,displayName)"` — will attach CSV.

Mike R: I'll export RBAC policies from the infra repo and put them in the drive. Ping me if you need a diff-friendly format.

Kelly D: I'll attach the audit checklist & list of acceptable artifacts in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/SOC2-evidence (will set viewer perms to eng-security).

sec-bot: Reminder: calendar slot suggested — "Security: Threat model + Access review" Wed 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Auto-created event link: https://zoom.us/j/xxxxxx

Sophia C: Can someone own access log extraction? I can help with retention queries but need infra owner to run the export. @Mike R?

Mike R: I can take the logs export. What timeframe do we need? Kelly?

Kelly D: For SOC2, we'll need the last 12 months for core services but we can start with last 90 days as a pre-read.

Anna L: Assigning owners for the pre-reads: Raj — service-account inventory; Mike — RBAC export + logs export (90d); Sophia — retention queries & log examples; Kelly — audit checklist & artifact list; Anna — updated threat model doc. Please upload by EOD Monday so we have time to review.

Raj P: ACK, I'll upload the CSV + a one-pager on assumptions.

Mike R: ACK, will put exports in the shared drive and add steps to reproduce.

Sophia C: ACK, will add sample queries and expected output.

Kelly D: ACK, will add checklist and mark which artifacts are "required" vs "nice-to-have."

Anna L: I'll follow up in this thread with the pre-read links and the calendar invite. If anyone needs a different time, speak now or file an availability change on the event. Thanks all :tada:
